caption: The drawing depicts a rooster standing on a base that resembles grass or foliage. The rooster has a red comb and wattle, a yellow beak, and brownish-black eyes. The feathers on the rooster's body are primarily brown, transitioning into darker shades of brown and black on the tail, with some yellow and white highlights on the tail feathers. The base on which the rooster stands is green with shading that suggests texture, and the edges of the base are a reddish-brown color. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, and there is a faint shadow beneath the base. Near the lower left edge, a thin, curved line extends outward.
title: Toy Rooster
